Bundled pngquant: 3.0.4
Bundled libimagequant: 4.5.0
Platform: Windows x64 (x86_64-pc-windows-msvc)

Built from the supplied pngquant-main and libimagequant-main source snapshots.
Rust 1.99.1 / Cargo 1.99.1 / Visual Studio 18 Community.

Build command (from an x64 Native Tools Command Prompt):
  set RUSTFLAGS=-C target-feature=+crt-static
  cargo build --release --locked --offline --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --features static,z-static

libpng, zlib, Little CMS 2 and the MSVC runtime are statically linked.
Only Windows system DLLs are required; no additional third-party DLLs.
The application still prefers a system pngquant found on PATH. Bundled
integration was tested with PATH isolated in the validation process only;
the machine's PATH and existing system pngquant were not changed.

Validation on the supplied samples:
  test.png: 380x287 palette PNG, 17194 -> 9383 bytes.
  Full and partial transparency remain present. Quantization is lossy:
  maximum alpha difference was 15/255; 12 originally transparent pixels
  became nearly transparent (alpha at most 5/255).
  metadata.png: iTXt retained normally and removed with --strip.
  Its ICC profile was converted to sRGB rather than copied unchanged.

COPYRIGHT contains the pngquant license and copyright notices.
libimagequant-COPYRIGHT contains the libimagequant license and notices.
README.txt contains the upstream pngquant 3 usage documentation.

Corresponding source archive:
  pngquant-3.0.4-libimagequant-4.5.0-windows-source.zip

The archive includes Cargo.lock, vendored dependency sources, libimagequant
and BUILD-WINDOWS.txt with offline build instructions. Distribute the archive
alongside the executable when using the GPL-3.0-or-later license, and retain
the applicable license notices. The archive is delivered separately and is
not included automatically by this project's PyInstaller configuration.
